candles.start: string - UNIX timestamp of candle start
candles.volume: string - base amount traded in period

field_descriptions.start: 5-minute candle start time (UNIX timestamp in seconds)
field_descriptions.high: Highest price recorded during the 5-minute interval
field_descriptions.low: Lowest price recorded during the 5-minute interval
field_descriptions.open: Price of first trade in the interval
field_descriptions.close: Price of last trade in the interval
field_descriptions.volume: Total volume in base currency traded during interval

message_types.snapshot: Initial candle data or complete candle for a period
message_types.update: New candle starting or ongoing period updates

timestamp_note: Convert UNIX timestamp to readable format with: datetime.fromtimestamp(int(start))
integration: Parse candles for moving averages, RSI, MACD and other technical indicators
